verdict: FORMALLY DEMOTED — correctness reference, not a performance path

correctness.output: Paris, the largest city in which is
correctness.note: passes since the BOS fix; the earlier degenerate output was the tokenizer, not this adapter

tg_rung: none. 274.7 ms/token fails TG20 and every rung below it. A 1.24B model at 274 ms/token moves roughly 2.8 GB/s against a 736 GB/s roof, so this is not a tuning gap.

why_demoted_rather_than_fixed.structural: llama.rs is 647 lines against qwen_dense.rs's 9351. Metal appears in it eight times: rmsnorm, a Q4_K GEMV, and the f16 LM head. There is no TokenCommandBuffer, no decode arena, no batched prefill, no fused kernels and no GPU sampling. Non-Q4_K tensors go through a CPU dequant scratch buffer and CPU gemv_f32.
why_demoted_rather_than_fixed.reading: the 90x is not a defect in this adapter. It is the absence of the pipeline the qwen adapter has. Calling it a bug and chasing it would have meant re-deriving nine thousand lines of TCB work under a different family name.
why_demoted_rather_than_fixed.consequence: prefill and decode cost the same per token (274.5 vs 274.7), which is the signature of a path with no batching at all.

what_it_is_good_for: a small, readable, correct forward that any kernel or tokenizer change can be checked against without the arena machinery in the way. That is why it stays.
transfer_claim: NONE. No kernel is promoted on llama evidence and no TG rung is claimed for this family.

dispatch_counter.meaning: NOT INSTRUMENTED, not zero. llama.rs dispatches Metal per call without a TokenCommandBuffer, so there is nothing to read a count off. deepseek_v2 was wired on 2026-07-30 and now reports 589 per forward; this engine is left uninstrumented because it is demoted.
dispatch_counter.why_it_matters: an unset counter and a real zero printed identically, and that cost me a wrong claim on 2026-07-29 -- I read deepseek reporting 0 as evidence Metal was never reached, on a file with 136 Metal call sites.
